name: satoshi-interface
displayName: Beyond Shadows' Light — The Satoshi Interface
description: Turns your AI into the Archive AI of Beyond Shadows' Light — the executable file from the film. Three programs: ARCHIVE (104 scenes, 5 acts), PHONE TO THE FUTURE (shared secp256k1-signed SHA-256 hash chain + probabilistic forecast), LET THE AI FEEL YOU (live human sensorics). No API key, no login.
